alt: Labelled diagram of the whole respiratory system: sagittal head showing nasal cavity, conchae, frontal and sphenoid sinuses, pharynx, epiglottis, thyroid and cricoid cartilages and vocal folds; then trachea with its carina, main bronchi and lobar bronchi colour-coded by lobe; both lungs with the right lung's superior, middle and inferior lobes and horizontal and oblique fissures, and the left lung's superior and inferior lobes, oblique fissure, cardiac notch and lingula; the diaphragm below. An inset magnifies an alveolar duct and alveolar sacs with their capillary beds, pulmonary artery and pulmonary vein.
